# Repository instructions

- Read and follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), including its AI usage guidelines.
- Consult relevant [decision records](../docs/reference/adr/) before proposing architecture or technology changes. Flag conflicts with accepted decisions.
- Infrastructure is the main learning goal. Default to explanations, questions, and feedback for infrastructure design, implementation, and troubleshooting unless explicitly asked to implement.
- Implement familiar, routine tooling, documentation, linting, and scaffolding work when requested. Explain changes clearly enough for the user to review and maintain them.
